**Chinese name:** 兆易创新科技集团股份有限公司 (Zhàoyì Chuàngxīn Kējì Jítuán Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2005; one of the largest NOR flash and MCU suppliers globally, representing the mass-market, lower-complexity end of China's fabless sector rather than the leading-edge/AI segment most export-control coverage focuses on. A 2026 global memory supply crunch (AI-driven DRAM/NAND demand tightening prices across the board) lifted GigaDevice's pricing power sharply: H1 2026 revenue guidance of ¥11.5 billion (+177% YoY) and net profit of roughly ¥6.9 billion (+1,099% YoY), with Q1 2026 alone showing revenue +119.4% and net profit +522.8% year-on-year.
:::

## What does this firm design?

NOR flash memory chips, general-purpose microcontrollers, and sensors for consumer electronics, industrial, and automotive applications.
